PLAN (ADR-0012 Spec 2: one engine, two input types):
1. cron.rs: CronLoopInput gains spec: Option<CronSpec> + catchup: CronCatchup + start_ts (serde default, replay-deterministic). Loop derives the tick body from spec.steps/graph -> runs through EXISTING run_workflow (the shared engine; call_workflow resolves via WorkflowResolver). Policy mapped CronSpecPolicy->CronPolicy for the existing evaluate machinery; catchup latest (current) vs skip (never fire missed ticks) via pure due_tick().
2. New CronSpecRegistration + CronSpecRegistry seam + CronManager::with_spec_registry; spec loops run under cron-spec:{name} (no collision with legacy cron:{name}). CronRegistration FROZEN (flywheel constructs it via full literal - sibling lane).
3. Engine/ mod.rs: NO change needed - the tick body IS a workflow run on the existing engine (documented deviation: bead listed engine/ but the shared-engine requirement is met by run_workflow reuse).
GATE: live test = real resonate serve + weekly-upgrade spec (start_ts in the past, schedule * * * * *) -> loop fires the most-recent due tick (catchup latest), call_workflow children execute (policy sink output asserts steps.probe/upgrade/verify), double start() resumes same run (no dup tick); unit tests for due_tick latest/skip + spec->body/policy mapping. Workflow invoke regression covered by existing suite.
Reserved: crates/toron-workflow/src/{cron,lib}.rs. Preserving bd-m7ac +4 output lines.
